title: Changelog spotlight collage: compact before/after UI flows and annotated callouts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact, reusable image pack for the upcoming release blog and changelog that highlights before/after Quickstart and Console onboarding flows. Deliver an annotated collage and a set of export-ready stills sized for blog hero, social, docs, and email. Focus is on clarity for product changes (new onboarding CTA, condensed stepper, and revised success state) while keeping file sizes small for CDN delivery. Deliverables: 1) Hero collage (desktop + mobile variants) showing side-by-side before/after flows with numbered callouts; 2) Three single-screen PNGs for key screens (welcome, quickstart flow, success modal); 3) Email header variant (600x200) and social preview (1200x628); 4) Editable Figma file with named components and export presets; 5) Accessibility notes (alt text, contrast ratios) and a short usage doc for Marketing/Docs. Constraints: work from current Console mocks in Figma file "Redwood/Console/Changelog-Assets"; avoid introducing new UI patterns that need engineering signoff; final images must fit existing doc grid and responsive breakpoints. Localization: prepare two overlay templates (EN, FR) so Marketing can swap copy without designer re-export. Performance: export WebP + PNG fallbacks and provide recommended CDN cache headers.
